notes: THE WHOLE FULL LAYER WAS INVERTED. Every phases[N].side said Pantheon and the difficulty block said HARD 8/10 with an 8.5/10 carry threat, while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both said Neeko on all seven rows and the owner win rate is 57.93% over 145 games. I moved all seven sides to Neeko with matched whys and ratings, and brought diff, tone, diffRating, carryRating, breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t down with them. On the diff token I chose "EVEN" (with the yellow tone used by the other even entries) because it is a token I have seen in this data set; a 57.93% win rate with a 7/7 chart probably deserves a favourable token instead, but I will not invent one the renderer may not know — see questionsForUser. BEST ADD: Aegis Assault carries the channel flag, so Tangle-Barbs or Pop Blossom cancels it outright — that was absent from both layers and it is the cleanest thing a Neeko can do in this matchup. It pairs with what the content layer already knew (the shield only covers the front). FABRICATION REMOVED: phases[4].why's "3-second knockup". LEFT ALONE: the entire content layer except spikes[3].text — it was already accurate, correctly gendered and Pantheon-specific, and it is the source I aligned the full layer to. breakdown.feeding, breakdown.spikes and report[2], [6], [7], [8], [10], [11], [12] were left as written.
